message: x-fern-sdk-return-value has no effect on endpoint noContent: its success response has no JSON content, and Fern only applies it to JSON responses.
x-fern-sdk-return-value has no effect on endpoint textResponse: its success response has no JSON content, and Fern only applies it to JSON responses.
x-fern-sdk-return-value has no effect on endpoint errorsOnly: the operation has no 200, 201, 202, 204 or default response, and Fern only applies it to JSON responses.
x-fern-sdk-return-value has no effect on endpoint sseStream: it streams server-sent events (x-fern-streaming format: sse), and Fern only applies it to non-streaming JSON responses.

Response must be an object in order to return a property as a response: endpoint conditionWithoutResponse has an x-fern-streaming stream-condition without a response schema, so Fern imports its non-streaming response as an untyped value and x-fern-sdk-return-value cannot select a property from it.
